basis: FASLG-related ALPS is an immune dysregulation disorder defined by defective lymphocyte apoptosis and nonmalignant lymphoproliferation.
Microcephaly, developmental impairment and epilepsy define a brain disorder; muscle atrophy has no established frequency.
TYK2 deficiency impairs immunity; recurrent infections do not establish direct, common damage to another organ.
Subcutaneous lipomatous overgrowth with partial lipodystrophy defines an adipose storage/distribution disorder; peripheral neuropathy frequency is unspecified.
The supplied ancestry identifies an inherited neurodegenerative disorder; radiation sensitivity alone establishes no additional organ damage.
Cleft palate, congenital heart malformation and intellectual disability are the defining oral, cardiac and neurodevelopmental abnormalities.
Spastic ataxia reflects central nervous system dysfunction; supranuclear gaze abnormalities and dysphagia do not establish separate eye or gut damage.
Segmental cranial dystonia causes blepharospasm and oromandibular movements without defining intrinsic eye, oral tissue or skeletal muscle disease.
Carcinoma originates in renal parenchymal or renal pelvic epithelium; metastatic sites are not defining common organ involvement.
Umbrella for inflammatory and degenerative connective tissue and joint disorders; an immune mechanism or visceral damage is not shared across the group.
Paroxysmal kinesigenic dyskinesia is a neurologic movement disorder; dystonia does not establish intrinsic muscle damage.
Malignant mesenchymal tumour arising in soft connective tissues; no additional organ of origin or common direct organ damage is specified.
Congenital severe neutropenia is a blood-cell disorder and innate immune deficiency; associated B-cell reduction further supports immune involvement.
Skeletal dysplasia affects vertebrae, epiphyses and metaphyses, with limb deformities and joint degeneration.
Primary breast carcinoma; breast is outside the specified axes, irrespective of its integumentary ancestry.
Structural cerebral cortical malformation causes epilepsy and cognitive or motor impairment.
Defined by defective cellular or humoral immunity; no specific blood-cell abnormality or damaged visceral organ applies across the umbrella.
Defined as a nervous system disorder spanning neurodevelopmental impairment, epilepsy and episodic ataxia.
Oral ulcers define immune-mediated disease; skin lesions occur in >50% and uveitis in ~30-70%. Vascular and articular manifestations omitted at cap; supplied CNS frequencies overstate prevalence.
PDX1-associated monogenic diabetes affects endocrine pancreatic function; exocrine pancreatic injury is not established for MODY4.
Severe immune-mediated cutaneous drug reactions; oral, ocular and visceral injury varies by subtype and is not established as common across the umbrella.
Ependymal tumour arising in the supratentorial central nervous system.
Occlusion of the ophthalmic artery directly compromises ocular circulation and causes severe ischemic injury to the globe.
Defined by hepatic small-vein occlusion and combined immunodeficiency; pulmonary fibrosis and neurologic injury are occasional; recurrent infections are separate diseases.
HNF1A-associated monogenic diabetes affects endocrine pancreatic function; the gene name does not establish liver disease, and diabetic complications are separate diseases.
